definition: שׂוֺרָה Isa 28:5 probably dittograph for following שְׂעֹרָה (Koppe We Che and others; ᵐ5 ᵑ6 omitted); > ᵑ9 Ges Di and others in rows (adverb acc; but Late Hebrew שׁוּרָה , Arabic , Lag GGN 1889, 298 ; compare Vogelst Landwirthsch. 41 who favours ׳ שׁ in Isaiah. More plausible would be some grain, as שורה Zinjirli Inscription, Lzb 374 Sachau Panammu 23 ).
